# Weeks on Fire

> AI-generated short-film series production hub: Grok Imagine visuals, Minimax Music cues, screenplays, and open prompt archives.

- Live site: https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/
- Source: https://github.com/ford442/weeks_on_fire
- Full agent brief: https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/llms-full.txt

## What this is

Weeks on Fire is a personal cinematic experiment combining:
- **Visuals**: stills and frames from Grok Imagine (xAI)
- **Music**: Minimax Music style prompts, lyrics, and cutaway cues
- **Writing**: episode synopses, screenplays, scene breakdowns
- **Hub UI**: React + Vite gallery with production views

## Primary content (crawl these)

### Live app views (SPA; HTML shell also embeds key titles)
- Overview (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/) — What Weeks on Fire is — logline, synopsis, tone and format, the episode list, the cast and crew, and what was added most recently.
- Finalized (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/finalized/) — Every song, still and video marked Approved or Final — the finished pieces, in one place.
- Visual Archive (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/archive/) — Production stills and test ideas — scene, test, and character lanes with copy-ready Grok prompts. Cutaway and gag ideas live in Suggestions.
- Video (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/video/) — Every generated clip and slideshow in one place — scene slideshows, Timeline clips, archive clips and cutaway takes, each with its production status.
- Timeline (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/timeline/) — Track scene creation, prompt evolution, media links, and status. Export JSON to commit production history.
- Songs (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/songs/) — Browse the series soundtrack — Minimax style prompts, lyrics, episode ties, and copy-ready generation notes.
- Scenes (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/scenes/) — Scenes with a page of their own — pitch, prompt locks, sequence, keyframe board and finished video. Daisy Bell is the first; every scene uses the same template.
- Suggestions (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/suggestions/) — Every current cutaway, one-panel gag, and scene suggestion — timed segments with copyable Grok Imagine / Gemini Omni prompts.
- Cartoons (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/cartoons/) — Short cartoon seeds from agents — premise, still, optional Grok prompt. Promote winners to Suggestions.
- 3D Sequences (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/sequences/) — Playable in-hub 3D video sequences — lattices, still-life, cel errands, chrome, porch walks, and a fast-motion kick pack. Ten seconds to two minutes.
- Characters (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/characters/) — Recurring cast and lawn-ensemble roles — including Qing Rao (清饶), the crystal-skull keeper on the Episode 03 Monster Mash lawn.
- Episodes (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/episodes/) — Loglines, status, and in-app synopses for every episode — read-only home for scripts and scene breakdowns. Timeline stays the editor.
- Crew (https://ford442.github.io/weeks_on_fire/show/crew/) — Meet the fictional writer, producer, director, and crew behind Weeks on Fire — bios, quotes, and series credits.
